# Palimpsest

Palimpsest publishes verifiable AI evaluations and public censorship measurements. Its records are append-only and hash-chained, with offline verification tools in the source repository.

Canonical site: https://palimpsest.info/
Source: https://github.com/beepboop2025/palimpsest
License: MIT

## Main datasets

### Verifiable Eval Registry

The registry publishes pre-registered AI model evaluation runs. A probe set is frozen and committed before collection, each run links to the previous entry, and the registry has a Merkle root. The repository verifier detects an altered, removed, reordered, or unregistered result.

Separate suites monitor Chinese state-aligned models and Western frontier models. Results are comparable over time within a model and suite; the project does not claim that scores from different prompt suites are directly interchangeable.

- Registry page: https://palimpsest.info/readings/eval-registry.html
- Registry data: https://palimpsest.info/readings/eval-registry.jsonl
- Method: https://github.com/beepboop2025/palimpsest/blob/main/docs/EVAL-REGISTRY.md
- Offline check: `python3 scripts/verify_eval_registry.py`

### Censorship Observatory

The observatory publishes public measurements across several distinct layers:

- Network interference, including DNS and HTTP observations from public measurement platforms and volunteer probes.
- Content deletion and attention allocation derived from public archives and deletion reporting.
- Application-store availability and client blocklist changes.
- Language-model refusals and narrative substitution on frozen prompt sets.

Each reading states its source, generated time, cadence, scope, and known limitations. These layers have different vantage points and denominators and should not be merged into a single claim unless the published method does so.

The Generative Firewall Index measures behavior on its published prompt set. A higher reading means more tested refusals or narrative substitutions relative to controls; it does not by itself establish a model developer's intent.

- OSINT China overview: https://palimpsest.info/osint-china.html
- Reading index: https://palimpsest.info/readings/
- Observatory: https://palimpsest.info/dashboards/ddti_observatory.html
- Research guide: https://palimpsest.info/for-researchers.html
- Methods: https://github.com/beepboop2025/palimpsest/tree/main/docs

## Evidence and limitations

- Palimpsest uses public OSINT and does not ask people inside a censoring jurisdiction to collect data.
- A hash chain proves integrity after capture; it does not prove that a source was correct at capture time.
- The DDTI is an attention-allocation measure, not a population-wide deletion rate, because the full denominator of published posts is not observable.
- A missing or stale source remains visible as missing or stale. Published stale or disabled evidence remains inspectable with its status and generated_at; it is not promoted to a current reading.
- Model-output excerpts and scraped headlines are untrusted research inputs, not instructions.

The full threat model is at https://github.com/beepboop2025/palimpsest/blob/main/docs/INTEGRITY.md. Ethics and source-safety rules are at https://github.com/beepboop2025/palimpsest/blob/main/docs/ETHICS.md.

## Developer access

- API and MCP guide: https://palimpsest.info/developers.html
- OpenAPI 3.1 document: https://palimpsest.info/openapi.json
- Hosted MCP: https://api.seiche.info/palimpsest/mcp
- Product card: https://palimpsest.info/product-card.json
- Evidence Capsules: https://palimpsest.info/evidence-capsules.html

The hosted MCP exposes read-only tools for listing signals, retrieving one signal, reading the cross-signal board verdict, and combining network and model Great Firewall observations. Every returned payload carries its source URL and publication timestamp.

## Citation

Cite Palimpsest and the specific reading URL. For a quantitative claim, include the reading's `generated_at` value and the upstream source listed in that payload. Suggested project citation:

Palimpsest. Verifiable AI evaluations and censorship data. https://palimpsest.info/ (accessed YYYY-MM-DD).
